guidance.beginner: Start light and own the technique — leave 3–4 reps in the tank on every set.
guidance.intermediate: Work close to the target — keep 2–3 reps in reserve and add weight once all sets feel solid.
guidance.advanced: Push the working sets hard — 1–2 reps in reserve — and progress the weight weekly.
guidance.professional: Treat the target as a base for your programming — periodise intensity across the week.

bench-press.desc: The classic barbell press for chest, front delts and triceps.
bench-press.steps:
Lie on the bench, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched together.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with control, elbows about 45° from the torso.
Press back to lockout without bouncing the bar off your chest.

incline-dumbbell-press.desc: Pressing on an incline bench shifts the work to the upper chest.
incline-dumbbell-press.steps:
Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and sit back with dumbbells at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the upper chest.

overhead-press.desc: Standing barbell press that builds shoulders, triceps and core stability.
overhead-press.steps:
Hold the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside shoulders, elbows under the bar.
Brace your core and press the bar straight overhead.
Move your head slightly back so the bar path stays vertical.
Lower under control back to the shoulders.

tricep-pushdown.desc: Cable isolation movement for the triceps.
tricep-pushdown.steps:
Stand facing the cable stack with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the handle down until your arms are fully extended.
Let the handle rise slowly to a 90° elbow bend without moving your elbows.

lateral-raise.desc: Dumbbell isolation for the side delts — key for wider shoulders.
lateral-raise.steps:
Stand with dumbbells at your sides and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly — no swinging or shrugging.

squat.desc: The king of lower-body lifts: quads, glutes and core in one movement.
squat.steps:
Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down between your hips, knees tracking over the toes.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up.

romanian-deadlift.desc: Hip hinge that loads the hamstrings and glutes through a stretch.
romanian-deadlift.steps:
Hold the bar at hip level with a shoulder-width grip.
Push your hips back, letting the bar slide down your thighs.
Lower with a flat back until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

leg-press.desc: Machine compound for quads and glutes with minimal back load.
leg-press.steps:
Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the platform until your knees are near 90°, keeping your lower back on the pad.
Press back up without locking the knees out hard.

leg-curl.steps:
Set the pad just above your heels and grip the handles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes in a controlled arc.
Return slowly without letting the stack slam down.

calf-raise.desc: Standing raise that targets the gastrocnemius.
calf-raise.steps:
Stand with the balls of your feet on an edge, heels hanging.
Rise as high as possible onto your toes and pause.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the calves.

deadlift.desc: Full-body barbell pull — posterior chain, grip and back thickness.
deadlift.steps:
Stand with mid-foot under the bar, grip just outside your legs.
Flatten your back, brace, and push the floor away.
Keep the bar against your body until you stand tall.
Hinge and bend your knees to lower it under control.

barbell-row.desc: Bent-over pull for lats, mid-back and rear delts.
barbell-row.steps:
Hinge to roughly 45° with a flat back, bar hanging at knee level.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows driving back.
Lower with control without letting the torso drop.

pull-up.desc: Bodyweight vertical pull for lats and biceps.
pull-up.steps:
Hang from the bar with a grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, elbows driving down.
Lower all the way to straight arms on every rep.

seated-cable-row.desc: Horizontal cable pull for mid-back thickness.
seated-cable-row.steps:
Sit tall with knees slightly bent and grab the handle.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Let your arms extend fully without rounding your back.

face-pull.desc: Rope pull for rear delts and rotator-cuff health.
face-pull.steps:
Set the rope at face height and grab it with thumbs pointing back.
Pull toward your face, spreading the rope past your ears.
Pause with the upper back squeezed, then return slowly.

bicep-curl.steps:
Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly to full elbow extension.

hammer-curl.desc: Neutral-grip curl for the biceps and forearms.
hammer-curl.steps:
Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up, keeping the neutral grip the whole way.
Lower under control without letting the elbows drift back.

plank.desc: Isometric core hold for trunk stability.
plank.steps:
Support yourself on forearms and toes, body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and glutes — no sagging or piked hips.
Breathe steadily and hold for the target time.

ab-wheel-rollout.desc: Advanced anti-extension exercise for the entire core.
ab-wheel-rollout.steps:
Kneel with your hands on the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward as far as you can keep the lower back neutral.
Pull back with your abs — not your arms — to return.

hip-thrust.desc: The most direct barbell exercise for glute strength.
hip-thrust.steps:
Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Drive through the heels until your hips are fully extended.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, chin tucked.
Lower with control until your hips are just above the floor.

glute-bridge.desc: Bodyweight bridge that wakes up the glutes and hamstrings.
glute-bridge.steps:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat near your glutes.
Push through the heels and lift your hips to a straight line.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

bulgarian-split-squat.desc: Rear-foot-elevated single-leg squat — quads, glutes and balance.
bulgarian-split-squat.steps:
Stand a stride ahead of a bench and rest your rear foot on it.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.

wrist-curl.desc: Isolation for the wrist flexors on the inner forearm.
wrist-curl.steps:
Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up, wrists past your knees.
Lower the dumbbells by opening your hands slightly.
Curl the wrists up as far as possible and squeeze.

reverse-wrist-curl.desc: Isolation for the wrist extensors on the outer forearm.
reverse-wrist-curl.steps:
Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Lift the backs of your hands upward as far as possible.
Lower slowly — use lighter weight than regular wrist curls.

dips.desc: Bodyweight press for the triceps and lower chest.
dips.steps:
Support yourself on parallel bars with arms locked.
Lower until your shoulders are just below the elbows, torso leaning slightly forward.
Press back up without flaring the elbows out.

push-up.desc: The fundamental bodyweight press for chest, shoulders and triceps.
push-up.steps:
Place your hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows about 45° from the torso.
Push back up, keeping the core tight.

crunch.desc: Short-range abdominal flexion — safe and simple.
crunch.steps:
Lie with knees bent and hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulder blades off the floor, ribs toward the pelvis.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

seated-calf-raise.desc: Seated raise emphasising the deeper soleus muscle.
seated-calf-raise.steps:
Sit with the pad on your knees and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Raise your heels as high as possible and pause.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
